The Ducks, led by 14th-year head coach [[Dana Altman]], played their home games at [[Matthew Knight Arena]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac–12 Conference]]. They competed in the [[2024 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2024 NCAA Tournament]], clinching a spot after beating Colorado 75–68 in the [[2024 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 Tournament]] final. This was the final season that the Ducks were members of the Pac-12 conference, as they joined the [[Big Ten Conference]] on July 1, 2024. ==Previous season== {{main|2022–23 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team}} The [[2022–23 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Ducks]] finished the season 21–15, 12–8 in Pac-12 play to finish in 4th place for the regular season. They defeated [[2022–23 Washington State Cougars men's basketball team|Washington State]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before losing to [[2022–23 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] in the semifinals. They did not receive an invitation to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], but did receive a bid to the [[2023 National Invitation Tournament|NIT tournament]] as a No. 1 seed. They defeated [[2022–23 UC Irvine Anteaters men's basketball team|UC Irvine]] 84–58 in their first round matchup, and defeated [[2022–23 UCF Knights men's basketball team|UCF]] 68–54 in their second round matchup.
